BirdynamicPkg

The R package ‘BirdynamicPkg’ enables modelling the demographic impact of windfarms on seabird species following the methodology developed in the Bird Dynamic project led by Thierry Chambert and Aurélien Besnard (see report and scientific article). The R package was created to support the Bird dynamic Shiny App created to apply the methodology to Mainland France. The R package enables running the analyses that run in the Shiny App, but with more flexibility by adding your own colonies or editing species attributes.

Installation

You can install the development version of BirdynamicPkg from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("BaptisteAverly/BirdynamicPkg")

Check this webpage for the documentation of the package and associated vignette.
